mentions.name: curyo.xyz
mentions.description: A rating system for the web designed for the age of AI, providing new quality signals. It uses zero-knowledge proofs for proof of personhood without sharing personal data, gamified reputation as a conviction signal, a blind voting phase to fight herding, and a public ledger/blockchain in the background for transparency.
mentions.problem: The web needs better and new quality signals in the age of AI; the current rating system implementation is far from perfect, and the team seeks feedback to balance being hard to attack with being user-friendly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on curyo.xyz. The main idea is to create a new rating system for the age of AI, since we think we need better/new quality signals for the web.
